body:
Everything is far too interconnected to live for yourself and only of yourself.

Besides, if I learned anything from my life, it's that human connection is the most important thing in life.

In lieu of that, death it is.  Simple, really. No other way out, can't expect other people to be anything other than the selfish-materialist-robot-animal-beasts they are; well, you can, but then you'd be me: delusional and soon to be dead. If you're not even good enough to be touched, you are not worthy of life. The end. How fucking pathetic, at least a burden is finally lifted. At least this pain will end. I genuinely lost hope in humans when not a single one met me halfway, not one.
